diagnosis: The gRPC method updateBillingAddress processes client updates forwarded from Envoy. It reads customer_id directly from the client's protobuf request message and modifies the target customer document in MongoDB without verifying that the authenticated session corresponds to that specific customer. An attacker can overwrite the billing profile of arbitrary customers to disrupt recurring payments or redirect physical invoices.
